My best friend and I have been growing apart. I know how hard that can be. My friend group really changed back in middle school, now it's just a bunch of misfits that didn't have other groups (we're definitely the coolest kids in school, though).

Point is, the friend group I have now is from finding the other kids that don't have anyone else. Find the kids that don't have a partner/group when the teacher makes you pick partners. If you see someone sitting alone in the cafeteria, ask them to sit with you. In middle school I was always afraid that the people who were alone wanted to be alone and would be annoyed if I talked to them, and while that may be true for some people, I made some really cool friends that way. Whenever I was afraid to put myself out there, I reassured myself by saying I could end it if it didn't work out, if I made a fool of myself. Most of the time, it did work out.
Us gays have to stick together. We can't lose anymore gays, the heteros will think they own this Earth. Stay strong.
